item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report states that demonstrations against the electoral process and violence targeting electoral workers, offices, and materials rose in 2023, while a contested election resulted in unrest, violence against perceived illegitimate winners, and suppression of political opposition by those in power.","notes":["The excerpt states that these incidents rose in 2023; it does not specifically limit the increase to the voting period."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In October 2023, RSF reported that journalist Stanis Bujakera Tshiamala had been detained since September 8 and urged presidential candidates to support dropping charges against him and other arbitrarily detained journalists. RSF recorded 123 arbitrary arrests of journalists from June 2020 to September 2023, three journalists murdered in prior years, and ranked the DRC 124th of 180 countries in its 2023 World Press Freedom Index; it proposed ten press-freedom commitments for candidates, including a moratorium on work-related arrests, investigations of murders, media-law reform, and reforms to make the public broadcaster a public-service medium and strengthen the regulator.","notes":["The excerpt does not expressly describe the proposed public-broadcaster and regulator measures as establishing their independence."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0027-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
